prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: deployable portfolio website concept screenshot
Primary request: Create a polished desktop website mockup for a game developer portfolio with a meaningful chatbot. This is concept 2 of 5 and should focus on a guided portfolio navigator rather than a standard landing page.
Scene/backdrop: full-browser screenshot of a website where the main experience is a step-by-step guided journey through the developer's best work
Subject: a guided portfolio navigator layout with a top progress path such as Overview, Games, Skills, Q&A. The center area shows one featured game at a time with impact metrics, role, lessons learned, and technology. A compact assistant module asks contextual questions and suggests the next section to open.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web product mockup, interview-friendly, practical and elegant
Composition/framing: wide desktop view, strong vertical rhythm, guided storytelling layout, clear sequencing and next-step affordances
Lighting/mood: editorial, calm, deliberate
Color palette: sand and off-white base, forest green accents, charcoal typography, small coral CTA accents
Materials/textures: subtle paper-like depth, rounded panels, restrained shadows
Text (verbatim): "Hong Jinho", "Guided Tour", "Games", "Skills", "Q&A", "Tech"
Constraints: prioritize a narrative flow that helps first-time visitors understand projects and personal strengths together; show games, developer profile, technology, and chatbot in one coherent system; no watermark
Avoid: sidebar-heavy duplication of concept 1, collage, sci-fi styling, excessive gradients, noisy backgrounds
summary: Concept 02 frames the portfolio as a guided tour with explicit progression, helping first-time visitors choose what to learn next while the assistant nudges them through projects and skills.
generation_notes: Generated with the built-in image_gen tool in default mode. Chosen to represent the strongest step-by-step exploration flow in Set B, distinct from card-grid and dashboard patterns.
